papers.title: Techno-economic and environmental assessment of next-generation battery-powered farming robots
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Decarbonizing agriculture without compromising productivity is a major challenge under rising input costs and labor scarcity. Autonomous battery-powered agricultural robots (ABARs) could help by reducing dependence on conventional machinery and enabling more precise application of inputs, but their system-level economic and environmental performance remains unclear. Here, we integrate total cost of ownership and life cycle assessment to evaluate a small ABAR for cradle-to-farm-gate crop production of strawberries, onions, lettuce, and peanuts under organic and non-organic management. Across modeled scenarios, benchmarked costs range from 76% below to 17% above literature-based reference ranges, while greenhouse-gas emissions fall within or below reported ranges. Variable inputs dominate both outcomes, contributing 72–90% of costs and 72–95% of global-warming impacts, with seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation water as main drivers. These results suggest that ABAR value depends less on the platform than on the ability of autonomous operation to reduce input use and labor demand.
papers.summary_ko: 배터리 구동 농업 로봇(ABAR)의 전과정평가(LCA)와 총소유비용(TCO)을 통합 분석하여 딸기, 양파, 양상추, 땅콩 재배에서의 경제성과 환경성을 평가했다. 비용과 온실가스 배출 모두 비료, 종자, 관개수 등 가변 투입재가 72~95%를 차지하는 주요 요인으로 나타났다. 자율주행 로봇의 가치는 플랫폼 자체보다 투입재와 노동력 절감 능력에 더 좌우된다는 결론을 제시했다.

papers.title: Solvent Toughened Glass Gel Electrolyte for High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT In situ polymerization electrolytes hold great promise for high‐energy‐density lithium‐metal batteries but often require additional separators due to their limited mechanical strength. Here, inspired by “glassy gels”, we developed a free‐standing glass gel electrolyte by introducing tributylmethylphosphonium dimethyl phosphate ([P 4441 ] [DMP]) into a poly(acrylic acid) (PAA) matrix. Strong non‐covalent interactions between [P 4441 ] [DMP] and PAA chains generate a tough and homogeneous network while enabling efficient ion transport. The resulting glass gel electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 2.2 mS cm −1 , a Li + transference number of 0.59, a tensile strength of 30 MPa, and an elongation of up to 700%. The solvent‐toughened scaffold effectively confines the liquid electrolyte and mitigates parasitic reactions with Li metal. Consequently, Li||Li symmetric cells achieve stable cycling for 1900 h at 3 mA cm −2 with an areal capacity of 3 mAh cm −2 . Li//NCM811 cells retain 90% of their capacity after 420 cycles, while Li//LiCoO 2 cells exhibit stable cycling for over 290 cycles at 1 C with a cutoff voltage of 4.6 V. This work provides a robust strategy for designing free‐standing electrolytes for high‐energy‐density lithium‐metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 폴리아크릴산(PAA)에 포스포늄계 이온성 액체([P4441][DMP])를 도입해 자립형 글래스겔 전해질을 개발했다. 2.2 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 30 MPa의 인장강도를 가지며, Li 금속과의 부반응을 억제해 Li||Li 대칭셀에서 1900시간 안정적 사이클링을 구현했다. Li//NCM811 및 Li//LiCoO2 완전셀에서도 각각 420회, 290회 이상의 장기 사이클 안정성을 보였다.

papers.title: Liquid Metal Spheres Achieving Stable Residual SEI for Dendrite‐Free Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium dendrite growth represents the primary factor hindering the commercialization of high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries, as it gives rise to safety hazards and low Coulombic efficiency. Surface morphology of deposited lithium is particularly affected by solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) and current collectors. Herein, we propose a current collector coated by spherical GaIn liquid metal nanoparticles encapsulated in a carbon layer (GaIn@C), which are spontaneously formed by the physical properties of liquid metal. This three‐dimensional spherical GaIn@C layer shows remarkable structure stability and avoids the tip effect during deposition of lithium, thus maintaining a stable residual SEI (rSEI) and dendrite‐free morphology over the repeated plating/stripping processes. The dendrite‐free lithium deposition behavior on GaIn@C layer was revealed via multiphysics simulation, ex‐situ deposition observation, in situ optical experiments, and in situ impedance analysis. Uniform deposition process of lithium half‐cell achieves a cycle life of up to 3500 h at an areal deposition capacity of 5 mAh cm −2 . Anode‐free full cell maintains specific capacity of 172.9 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles at 1C, with capacity retention of 99.9% and energy density of pouch battery exceed 410 Wh kg −1 . This study presents a general synthetic strategy for the construction of a current collector with stable residual SEI in dendrite‐free lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: GaIn 액체금속 나노입자를 탄소층으로 감싼 구형 집전체(GaIn@C)를 제안해 리튬 증착 시 팁 효과를 억제하고 덴드라이트 없는 균일한 리튬 증착을 구현했다. 잔류 SEI(rSEI)를 안정적으로 유지하여 Li 반셀에서 최대 3500시간의 사이클 수명을 달성했다. 무음극 완전셀에서는 410 Wh/kg 이상의 에너지밀도와 99.9%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Formulating the Dual‐Function Separator‐Enabled Homogenizing Ion Flux in Nonflammable Phosphate toward High Stable Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The high‐energy lithium metal battery employing a nonflammable phosphate electrolyte is an attractive strategy to resolve the notorious safety trouble. Unfortunately, the sluggish ion dissociation and transport kinetics, strong interaction of Li + ‐phosphates, and uncontrollable secondary reaction between the electrode and electrolyte interfaces severely impedes the cycling stability of lithium metal batteries. Herein, the dual‐function separators with fast ion dissociation and transport capability are designed to enable the homogeneous and efficient ion flux in nonflammable phosphate electrolyte. By virtue of the regulating effect of the designed dual‐function separator, the homogeneous distribution of the ion field and electric field are constructed, thus reducing the concentration polarization among nonflammable phosphate electrolyte and weakening the parasitic reaction of the metallic lithium anode and nickel‐rich cathode with the electrolyte. The Li||Li symmetrical cells exhibit remarkable cycling stability of above 1000 h at 2 mA cm −2 . Moreover, the Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) battery exhibits above 90% capacity retention after 300 cycles at 1C. Furthermore, stable bidirectional electrode‐electrolyte interfaces are also realized after cycling. This approach holds great promise for regulating the ion flux in nonflammable electrolyte, and would encourage more separator engineering design to optimize ionic transport behavior.
papers.summary_ko: 불연성 인산계 전해질에서 이온 흐름을 균일화하는 이중기능 분리막을 설계해 리튬 금속 전극과 니켈리치 양극의 부반응을 억제했다. Li||Li 대칭셀은 1000시간 이상 안정적으로 작동했으며, Li||NCM811 완전셀은 300회 사이클 후 90% 이상의 용량 유지율을 보였다. 이를 통해 불연성 전해질 기반 리튬 금속 배터리의 안전성과 사이클 안정성을 동시에 향상시켰다.

papers.title: Submolecular Selenium Enables Low‐Pressure and Recyclable All‐Solid‐State Li–Se Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state lithium‐selenium (Li–Se) batteries offer high energy density and intrinsic safety, but their practical deployment is hindered by sluggish solid‐state redox kinetics, large volume fluctuations, and unstable solid‐solid interfaces, particularly under low stack pressure. Here we report a submolecular Se x cathode by converting crystalline cyclo‐Se 8 into amorphous single‐atom and short‐chain Se (Se x , x < 4) species anchored on graphene (Se x @G), which increases the electronic conductivity from 6.3 × 10 −5 to 13 S cm −1 and Li + diffusivity from 1.7 × 10 −14 to 2.0 × 10 −11 cm 2 s −1 . Meanwhile, a Li 2 O‐nanoshell‐modified sulfide solid electrolyte is designed to stabilize the interface against both Li metal and Se cathode. As a result, all‐solid‐state Li–Se batteries deliver the theoretical capacity of 673 mAh g −1 at 0.1 C and retain 86% capacity over 2800 cycles at 3 C under 8 MPa, with stable operation down to −30°C. All‐solid‐state Li–Se pouch cells further achieve an energy density of 420 Wh kg −1 and 94% capacity retention after 300 cycles under 2.5 MPa. Post‐mortem analysis reveals that the submolecular Se x species are not only structurally preserved but also recyclable after electrochemical cycling within the solid‐state reaction environment. This work establishes submolecular chalcogen chemistry as a new design paradigm for low‐pressure, recyclable, and high‐energy all‐solid‐state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 결정질 Se8를 그래핀 위에 비정질 단분자/단쇄 셀레늄(Sex, x<4)으로 전환해 전자전도도와 Li+ 확산도를 크게 높인 전고체 리튬-셀레늄 배터리용 양극을 개발했다. Li2O 나노쉘로 황화물 고체전해질 계면을 안정화해 0.1C에서 673 mAh/g의 이론용량과 3C·2800회 사이클에서 86%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다. 파우치셀에서는 420 Wh/kg의 에너지밀도와 -30°C에서의 저온 구동을 보였다.

papers.title: Stabilizing hydrogen bonds and engineering multi-component hetero-solvation architecture for dendrite-free zinc metal anodes
papers.abstract_en: Aqueous zinc-ion batteries (AZIBs) are promising candidates for renewable grid energy storage, but their development is limited by non-uniform zinc deposition, hydrogen evolution reactions (HERs), and byproduct growth at the zinc anode interface. Herein, a dual-regulation strategy integrating bulk solvation reorganization with interfacial dynamic electrostatic shielding is developed by introducing a trace amount of 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium iodide (BMIMI, BI) into a Zn(OTf) 2 aqueous electrolyte. Multi-dimensional microscopic spectra and quantitative molecular dynamics simulations confirm that the co-incorporation of BMIM + cations and I − anions establishes a diversified I − -H 2 O-OTf − hetero-primary solvation sheath, disrupting the chemical degradation pathways caused by free water aggregation. Due to its electrostatic adsorption energy advantage on multiple crystal planes, BMIM + preferentially occupies active sites to form a dynamic cation shielding field. This forces Zn 2+ to diffuse away smoothly from local tip protrusions and induces lateral planar epitaxial growth along the dense (002) preferred crystal plane. Consequently, the electrolyte shows stability within the fundamental potential window during cyclic voltammetry tests, and the interfacial desolvation energy barrier decreases from 51.29 to 23.28 kJ mol −1 . This affords the Zn//Cu battery a stable Coulombic efficiency of 99.74%, and the Zn//Zn symmetric battery achieves a lifespan exceeding 7500 h under variable loads and high areal capacities. In full-cell applications, the cell maintains a capacity retention of 84.07% after 5000 cycles at a high current density of 2 A g −1 . Combined with ex-situ distribution of relaxation times and dynamic impedance evolution, this strategy confirms the feasibility of the system for industrial-grade variable-load energy storage scenarios.
papers.summary_ko: BMIMI를 Zn(OTf)2 수계 전해질에 소량 첨가해 I⁻-H2O-OTf⁻로 구성된 다중 1차 솔베이션 셰시를 형성하고, BMIM+ 양이온의 동적 정전차폐 효과로 아연의 (002)면 우선성장을 유도했다. 이를 통해 탈솔베이션 에너지 장벽을 51.29에서 23.28 kJ/mol로 낮추고, Zn//Cu 셀에서 99.74%의 쿨롱효율, Zn//Zn 대칭셀에서 7500시간 이상의 수명을 달성했다.

papers.title: Anion‐Cation Targeted Regulation Enables Ultrafast and Stable Sodium Metal Batteries at Low Temperatures
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anion‐dominated solvation and artificial interfacial engineering have been intensively pursued for low‐temperature sodium‐metal batteries (SMBs), yet they face constraints from temperature‐sensitive solvation dynamics and interfacial control. Here we propose anion‐cation‐targeted regulation via Sn(OTf) 2 that simultaneously constructs a solvent‐reinforced solvation structure and electrochemically induces an alloy‐based solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) (Na 15 Sn 4 ), which goes beyond the prevailing anion‐centric strategy to address the critical challenges of SMBs at subzero temperatures. Competitive Sn 2+ ‐Na + coordination excludes PF 6 − from the primary solvation sheath, while OTf − and the ether groups of diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (DEGDME) coupling foster a solvent‐dominated configuration, substantially reducing the Na + desolvation energy barrier at low temperatures. This design enables Na||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cells to deliver a recorded 1050 cycles at −20°C and 20 C, and nearly 700 cycles at −50°C. Ah‐scale pouch cells sustain durable 450 cycles at −20°C, with a 6 Ah cell reaching 215 Wh kg −1 at 25°C (total cell mass). Our findings resolve the longstanding trade‐off between low‐temperature kinetics and stability in SMBs, offering a new design rationale beyond conventional interfacial engineering.
papers.summary_ko: Sn(OTf)2를 이용한 음이온-양이온 표적 조절 전략으로 용매가 우세한 솔베이션 구조를 형성하고 합금 기반 SEI(Na15Sn4)를 유도하여 저온 소듐 금속 배터리 성능을 개선했다. Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 셀은 -20°C·20C에서 1050회, -50°C에서 약 700회의 사이클을 달성했다. 6 Ah급 파우치셀은 -20°C에서 450회 사이클을 유지했고 25°C에서 215 Wh/kg의 에너지밀도를 보였다.
